entries.german: Reinhard von Uissigheim und seine Ehefrau Anna Pfal verkaufen mit Konsens des Grafen Thomas zu Rieneck an Heinrich Brun, Pfarrer zu Werbach, für die Frühmesse in der Pfarrkirche daselbst ihren sechsten Teil am Zehnt zu Uissigheim um 200 Gulden.
entries.english: Reinhard von Uissigheim and his wife Anna Pfal, with the consent of Count Thomas of Rieneck, sell their sixth share of the tithe at Uissigheim to Heinrich Brun, parish priest at Werbach, for the early mass in the parish church there, for 200 guilders.
facts: Count Thomas of Rieneck consented to the sale by Reinhard von Uissigheim and Anna Pfal.
Reinhard von Uissigheim and his wife Anna Pfal sold their sixth share of the tithe at Uissigheim to Heinrich Brun, parish priest at Werbach, for the early mass in the parish church.
